parameters.name: AuthParameters
parameters.description: The data structure of the authentication parameters.

parameters.name: ConnectionName
parameters.description: The name of the connection to be updated. The maximum length is 127 characters. The minimum length is 2 characters.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. The maximum length is 255 characters.

parameters.name: NetworkParameters
parameters.description: The data structure of the network configuration.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: The data source connection parameters (JSON object). For specific field definitions, call the GetConnectionType API and refer to the ParamsSchema in the response.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The connection type. Valid values: MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Http.
